Category D: Grade 10 completers who are ESC grantees
Category E: non-ESC Grade 10 completers from private schools

Must be promoted and enroll in a VP-participating SHS each year to keep the voucher
benefits: Tuition subsidy for 2 consecutive years of SHS starting Grade 11 (amounts not stated on the PEAC pages reviewed)

notes: Governed by DO 11, s. 2026 (revised E-GASTPE guidelines), which changed eligibility from SY 2026-2027. Category definitions and dates were read from PEAC's infographic images on the voucher-application page. Voucher values not recorded because they were not found on the pages reviewed. PEAC states the SHS VP is not a scholarship.

name: Quezon City Scholarship Program

Continuing education/vocational: enrolled in short courses or licensure/board/bar review at a city-recognized institution
benefits: SHS (all sub-categories): tuition grant up to PHP 20,000 + stipend PHP 10,000 per school year

Tertiary Academic: up to PHP 80,000 tuition + PHP 25,000 stipend

notes: Amounts are per school year maximums from the QC Scholars' Guide (last updated 18 Sep 2026). Based on Ordinance SP-3121 s. 2022 as amended by SP-3283 s. 2024. Application windows are announced by QCYDO and are not on the pages.
